camera.fov_note: Exact donor FOV UNVERIFIED (donor sensor constant unknown). M0.5's 'physically sane' 36 mm/f-400 derivation gave 2.90 deg V-FOV at 240 m/384 m but flattened depth into a top-down mosaic and was REJECTED on visual review. M0.6 restores the 216 mm display sensor (17.27 deg V-FOV) at 40 m/64 m; visual judgement won over the unverified derivation.
